tools.description: Produce and independently check a finite exact certificate for the supplied matrix: RREF, rational rank, complete rational nullspace basis and determinant (null for nonsquare matrices). tools.description: Construct and freshly check a concrete integer point disproving a false formal Q-polynomial identity. Exact normalization to zero reports polynomial_coefficient_identity, not failed search; that identity branch is not point-certified. For nonzero residuals try 0..current degree in each variable and keep the first nonzero residual. At most the SUM of current degrees plus one per variable, not Cartesian-grid enumeration or a general runtime complexity claim. Return exact point, left/right/mismatch values and producer-only per-variable trace; each constructed coordinate <=32. Only unrestricted formal polynomials in ordered algebraically independent variables over Q, characteristic zero. No quotient rings, rational functions, finite fields, constraints or user-restricted loci. No formal-proof or runtime-goal acceptance. Resource failure is inconclusive, never absence of a witness. Successful construction uses at most n+degree(nonzero normalized difference) trials, hence <=n+32<=40. The retained 264 hard cap is a compatibility limit, not the tight theorem. No extra normalization is performed solely for bound metadata. Normalization: <=8 variables, degree/depth 32, 1024 AST nodes, 256 terms, 256-bit literal components, 2048-bit coefficients and 100000 arithmetic steps. Sequential construction: <=264 substitution trials, 100000 term visits and 4096-bit evaluation values. Fresh checker: <=4096 AST nodes, no normalization required. Combined standalone request <=262144 bytes; bridge frame <=65536 bytes and output <=1048576 bytes. A standalone-valid request or witness may not fit the bridge. No caller-selected limits, paths, source, commands or model. Hashes bind content, not authenticity. Shared parser, Fraction arithmetic and runtime remain trusted.

matrix.description: One explicit matrix, at most 16 rows/columns and 256 cells. Runtime requires exactly rows entry lists of exactly cols coefficients, including empty shapes, and input coefficient components <=128 bits. Z restricts input tokens to integers; all computation and nullspace claims are over Q.

q_matrix.description: Explicit Q matrix with exact declared shape; certificate coefficient components <=2048 bits. Runtime checks canonical fractions and the shape required by the original matrix and rank.

system.description: One explicit A,b with one RHS. Runtime binds exact shapes and domain; RHS has exactly A.rows coefficients. Z restricts both A and b to integer tokens, but solutions are over Q.

system_certificate.description: Runtime checks against separately supplied expected A,b. A schema match is not certificate verification.

tools.description: Produce a certificate and independently verify it against the supplied original request. Only universal integral virtual-character arithmetic in a pinned fixed table, with exact class values in Q(sqrt(5)). The physical labels A/V and W/Wp remain distinct. Identification of this table with the stated group is an assumption, not a proved output. Genuine means nonnegative multiplicities, including zero, not geometric realization. No actual geometric/source instances, arbitrary theorem refutation, formal proof, Lean check or runtime goal acceptance. Expression limits: 127 nodes, depth 16, Sym^n(W) for 0<=n<=256; input coefficients <=2^63-1 in magnitude, intermediate/result coefficients <=2^256-1. Exact field components <=272 bits; request/certificate canonical byte limits 65536/262144. Bridge frame limits remain 65536 input bytes, 1048576 output bytes and 16384 JSON nodes; a standalone-valid certificate can exceed bridge limits. No caller-selected bounds, paths, code, commands or group tables. Failure and budget exhaustion carry no mathematical outcome. Schemas are structural, not arithmetic verification; hashes bind bytes, not authenticity. This is bounded deterministic software arithmetic, not an OS sandbox or hard wall-clock quota.

certificate.description: Certificate data only: schema conformance is not verification. The independent verifier revalidates the separately supplied expected request, reevaluates the fixed table over Q(sqrt(5)), and compares the entire canonical certificate. Runtime enforces 262144 canonical bytes, 8192 certificate data values and depth 32. Hashes bind bytes, not truth or authenticity.

character_result.description: Multiplicities are ordered 1,W,A,S4,D,T6,P,Wp,V. Dimensions and parity subtotals are signed, not evidence of genuineness. Genuine means all multiplicities are nonnegative, including zero; proper_virtual has a negative multiplicity. Center parity is based on nonzero support. Runtime recomputes every field; the schema does not prove agreement.

expression.description: Only fixed physical labels; A and V, and W and Wp, are distinct. Symmetric power means Sym^degree(W) only. Runtime enforces at most 127 expression occurrences and depth 16, including repeated shared objects.

field_value.description: Exact a+b*sqrt(5) as [a_num,a_den,b_num,b_den]. Runtime requires reduced fractions and positive denominators; zero is [0,1,0,1].

request.description: Bounded exact integral virtual-character arithmetic in one fixed table, with class values in Q(sqrt(5)). Input is at most 65536 bytes including canonical ASCII JSON. tools.description: Produce a formal split-bundle certificate and independently check it against the supplied original request. Formal supplied equivariant direct sums on P(W) only. The fixed physical table and the supplied splitting are assumptions, not proved object identifications. A is not V; W is not Wp. H0 and H1 are separately computed; Euler equality does not identify cohomology or splittings. Hom dimension is not map rank. No active research object identification, geometric realization, map-rank or embedding claim, formal proof, Lean check or runtime goal acceptance. Exact class values are in Q(sqrt(5)); no floating-point fallback. At most 32 blocks per bundle and 32 distinct requested twists; block/requested twists in [-64,64], multiplicity in [0,1000000], symmetric degree at most 128; result irreducible coefficients at most 128 bits. Request/certificate canonical byte limits 65536/262144, data depth 16, 8192 values, string/key length 256, integer magnitude 300 bits. Bridge limits remain 65536 input bytes, 1048576 output bytes and 16384 JSON nodes, so a standalone-valid certificate can exceed bridge limits. No caller-selected bounds, paths, code, commands, group tables, points or maps. Failure/budget exhaustion is inconclusive and carries no partial result. Schemas are data shapes, not arithmetic verification; hashes bind bytes, not truth or authenticity. Bounded deterministic software arithmetic is not an OS sandbox or hard wall-clock quota.

bundle.description: A supplied formal direct-sum multiset, not a recognized geometric bundle. Empty bundles and zero multiplicities are allowed; duplicate blocks add, but all block order and redundant presentations remain part of the exact request binding.

certificate.description: Certificate data only, not verified evidence. The independent checker revalidates a separately supplied expected request and recomputes the entire canonical certificate using exact class functions, without importing either producer or its request contract. Request hashes bind exact presentations and order, not only equivalent arithmetic. Hashes establish neither mathematical truth, provenance authenticity nor group identification.

base.const: P(W) with determinant-one W and standard O(1) linearization

character.description: Multiplicities use the exact order 1,W,A,S4,D,T6,P,Wp,V. H0, H1 and Hom are genuine; Euler can be proper virtual. Signed dimension zero need not mean a zero character. Runtime recomputes every field, including parity, negative support and exact class values; structural constraints do not prove those relationships or identify a geometric object.

cohomology_row.description: Degree is after twisting. H0/H1 depend on the supplied splitting, not merely its Euler character. Runtime independently verifies H0-H1 and signed Riemann-Roch; the schema does not infer vanishing from Euler data.

field_value.description: Exact a+b*sqrt(5), encoded [a_num,a_den,b_num,b_den]. Runtime enforces reduced fractions, positive denominators and canonical zero [0,1,0,1]. The schema bounds data components by the vendored 300-bit integer guard, not an arithmetic proof.

genuine_character.description: Multiplicities use the exact order 1,W,A,S4,D,T6,P,Wp,V. H0, H1 and Hom are genuine; Euler can be proper virtual. Signed dimension zero need not mean a zero character. Runtime recomputes every field, including parity, negative support and exact class values; structural constraints do not prove those relationships or identify a geometric object.

request.description: Formal cohomology on P(W) or Hom from the supplied source to target. Twists are ordered. No actual object identification, map rank, embedding or kernel inference. All numbers must be exact built-in integers at runtime, not bool, float or coerced strings. JSON Schema integer semantics alone cannot enforce lexical or Python type restrictions. Request/certificate byte limits are 65536/262144, including canonical ASCII JSON; depth 16, 8192 data values, 256-character strings/keys and 300-bit integer magnitudes are separately checked at runtime.

oneOf.description: Hom-character dimension counts all sheaf maps; the trivial-irrep multiplicity counts equivariant maps. Neither quantity is a rank of any map, and no injectivity, surjectivity, embedding or existence of a map with prescribed rank follows.
